Depends on the previous quests (handing in the addons takes 5 min)

The **Wayfarer** outfit is the final reward of the {wiki:Wrath of the Emperor Quest}. The two addons (Cape and Sedge Hat) are made by the {npc:Cranky Lizard Crone}, in Zao, from items you get in other quests: the {item:Old Cape} and the {item:Sedge Hat}. With everything complete you get the achievement **Peazzekeeper**.
Outfit: have completed the {wiki:Wrath of the Emperor Quest}.
Addons: have completed {wiki:The Spirit Will Get You Quest} so you can talk to {npc:Cranky Lizard Crone}.
Cape: have the {item:Old Cape}, a reward of {wiki:A Father's Burden Quest}.
Sedge Hat: have the {item:Sedge Hat}, a reward of {wiki:An Interest In Botany Quest}.
The dangers listed are those of the required quests (Wrath of the Emperor, The Spirit Will Get You, etc.); handing in the addons itself is not dangerous.
Complete the Wrath of the Emperor Quest
You do not need any items: the Wayfarer outfit is given as a reward for completing the {wiki:Wrath of the Emperor Quest}.
Complete {wiki:A Father's Burden Quest} to receive the {item:Old Cape}. Also complete {wiki:The Spirit Will Get You Quest}, without which {npc:Cranky Lizard Crone} will not talk to you.
Getting to the Cranky Lizard Crone

{npc:Cranky Lizard Crone} is in the {wiki:Souleater Mountains|Souleater Mountains}, in {wiki:Northern Zao|Northern Zao}, above the {wiki:Zao Rebel Camp} ({coord:33213,31058,9}). Go to **Farmine** by {wiki:Steamship} ({npc:Brodrosch} in Kazordoon or {npc:Gurbasch} in Cormaya: {key:hi}, {key:farmine}, {key:yes}) and from there to the rebels' hideout via the link you reactivated in the {wiki:Wrath of the Emperor Quest} (the teleports between Razachai, the Rebel Camp and the Inner Sanctum become available with that quest). From the Rebel Camp go up into the Souleater Mountains and head **southwest**, careful not to get cornered, to the Crone ({coord:33193,31045,6}).
The Souleater Mountains are full of {creature:Souleater|Souleaters}, {creature:Mutated Rat|Mutated Rats}, {creature:Mutated Bat|Mutated Bats} and {creature:Mutated Tiger|Mutated Tigers}.
Handing the Old Cape to the Crone

With the {item:Old Cape} in your backpack, talk to {npc:Cranky Lizard Crone}. Say {key:hi}, {key:cape} and {key:yes}. You receive the Cape addon. To return to Farmine, follow the last step of this guide (*Returning to Farmine*).
Complete {wiki:An Interest In Botany Quest} to receive the {item:Sedge Hat}.
Handing the Sedge Hat to the Crone

With the {item:Sedge Hat} in your backpack, talk to {npc:Cranky Lizard Crone}. Say {key:hi}, {key:hat} and {key:yes}. You receive the Sedge Hat addon; with both addons you earn the achievement **Peazzekeeper**. (The way to her is in the step *Getting to the Cranky Lizard Crone*, in section 2.)
Sedge Hat addon and Peazzekeeper achievement

Go back the same way to the Rebel Camp. In {npc:Chartan}'s room, the blue flame **south** of him takes you to the {wiki:Muggy Plains}; from there return to the Zao Steppe by the teleport and head **southwest** to the pass through the mountain ({coord:33085,31532,7}). Climb it with {spell:Levitate} (or parcels/boxes) and go **west** to the Farmine elevator. At the Steamship, {npc:Thorgrin} takes you to Kazordoon or Cormaya ({key:hi}, the destination, {key:yes}).
